item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompt diet changes across Treasure Coast
item.description: Five confirmed local cases of cyclospora have been reported since May, including 2 in St. Lucie County and 1 in Martin County, according to the Florida Department of Health.

item.title: President Trump to Attend World Cup Final in New Jersey with Stepped-Up Security
item.description: The World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey has been designated a Level 1 Special Event with President Trump attending the trophy presentation and enhanced security from multiple federal agencies.

item.title: Messi and Yamal Face Off in World Cup Final After Photographer's 2007 Photo Shoot
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort shot images in 2007 of a teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal for a charity calendar. The two now meet in Sunday's World Cup final with Argentina playing Spain.

item.title: Major League Baseball Restricts iPad Use in Dugouts to Block AI Decision-Making
item.description: MLB has made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to make in-game decisions about substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Snyder Drives in Five as St. Lucie Mets Hold Off Cardinals, 8-6
item.description:
